prompts.name: garden
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished 16:9 landscape background plate for a real-time anime-style 3D avatar companion. Scene: a sunlit garden terrace, pale warm stone paving, flowering planters and trailing vines at the far edges, leafy garden beyond, quiet spring morning. Style: tasteful semi-realistic hand-painted 3D game environment, soft physically plausible lighting, restrained detail, natural colors. Camera at standing adult eye level about 1.3m, facing level, perspective consistent with a full-body character viewed from about 3m. Composition: center 45 percent horizontally completely empty, wide clear unobstructed flat stone foreground across bottom 40 percent, paving extends out below the frame; an avatar will be composited with feet at horizontal center, 86 percent down the image. Keep horizon/back wall-floor junction above mid-height so feet clearly meet the foreground floor. No people, no animals, no foreground objects, no text, no labels, no logos, no floating platforms, no prepainted character shadow. Single scene, not a collage. Generate a widescreen landscape image.
